body_markdown:
Space power is a mission-critical capability, much like AI or semiconductors. Many space technologies vital to national security depend on reliable energy generated in orbit, but traditional rigid composite solar arrays can be slow to procure, costly to scale, and difficult to reconfigure.


Redwire’s **Extensible Low-Profile Solar Array (ELSA)** was developed to address these challenges, providing an innovative design engineered to minimize stowed volume and mass while preserving performance, accelerating production, and reducing cost.


Discover how flight proven heritage meets the next evolution of space power in the *Mission Report: ELSA. Engineered for Performance. Designed for Production. Ensuring Mission Readiness with Scalable Space Power Solutions.*


[Download the Mission Report](https://rdw.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/RDW26-167-ELSA-Mission-Report.pdf)
